Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Integration - SDK/Auth/Streaming weekly sync

Hi Carla —

Following our kickoff last week, attaching the updated Mutual Action Plan (NH-MAP-v1.3.xlsx) with the integration milestones pinned to the evaluation plan and closing timeline. Proposed weekly checkpoint cadence here.

High-level asks for this week (ETA EOW unless noted):
- SDK: quickstart + language bindings smoke tests (owner: Vivek)
- Auth: token exchange flow and sample config (owner: Vivek)
- Streaming & long-polling: baseline test harness (owner: Priyom)
- Tool calling/structured outputs: sample tool schema and example (owner: Monica)

Can we confirm the streaming test window on your side (sandbox credentials needed)? I included a short auth checklist (sdk-auth-checklist.md) and streaming playbook for reference.

Thanks — let me know if you'd like this as a standing 30-min weekly review or asynchronous updates in the MAP doc.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0176

Attachments: NH-MAP-v1.3.xlsx, sdk-auth-checklist.md

From: Carla Ruiz <carla.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration - SDK/Auth/Streaming weekly sync

Thanks Rafael —

Quick clarifying questions before we lock the MAP:
1) Auth: our infra requires mutual TLS for the token exchange in prod — can the sample config show mTLS + JWT fallback?
2) SDK: our mobile team needs Swift + Kotlin quickstarts; are those in scope for the initial integration or would that be a follow-on?
3) Streaming: do you have a recommended test corpus/size for simulating live telemetry (500–2,000 msgs/min)?

Procurement will also need a copy of the evaluation plan and the provisional SLA to proceed with PO timing — I'll loop them once we confirm the streaming window.

Appreciate it —
Carla
Director, Platform Integrations
Nimbus Health
carla.ruiz@nimbushealth.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Carla Ruiz <carla.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration - SDK/Auth/Streaming weekly sync

Carla —

Thanks for the questions. Quick answers and owners below (copying Priyom for streaming specifics):

1) Auth (owner: Vivek)
- We can provide an example mTLS setup + JWT bearer fallback. The sdk-auth-checklist.md includes sample nginx proxy config and cert rotation notes.
- For sandbox: we'll issue a client cert for your QA domain (expires in 30 days) and provide steps to import into your test devices.

2) SDK quickstarts (owner: Vivek)
- Swift + Kotlin quickstarts are not in the initial minimal smoke set but we can deliver them as part of the "mobile integration pack" in Sprint 2. For now we will supply the REST + TypeScript SDK quickstart + a WebSocket streaming example.

3) Streaming load (owner: Priyom)
- Priyom: recommended starting profile = 500 msgs/min for warmup, then ramp to 1,500 over 10 minutes; we can supply a small generator and pre-built VUs.

Action items I can own this sprint:
- Deliver mTLS + JWT sample (sdk-auth-checklist.md) — target: 2026-03-18 EOD
- Produce TS/REST quickstart + WebSocket streaming example — target: 2026-03-19

I'll attach a short engineering note with the cert procedures.

— Vivek
Sr. Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments: sdk-auth-checklist.md

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration - SDK/Auth/Streaming weekly sync

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick responses; had a short sync with Vivek this morning and captured the meeting notes + owners below. Putting these in the MAP as actions so procurement can see the impact on the close timeline. Link to the working MAP (read-only until we finalize): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPdocs

Meeting notes (17 Mar 2026)
- Confirmed sandbox certificate issuance and import steps (Vivek)
- Streaming harness: generator, VU script, and baseline dataset (Priyom)
- Tool calling: Monica will provide a sample tool schema (JSON) and a short runbook for mapping tool outputs to our structured format.

Action items (owners & ETA)
- Vivek: mTLS + JWT sample + cert issuance steps — 2026-03-18 EOD (BLOCKER until cert issued)
- Vivek: TS+REST quickstart + WebSocket example — 2026-03-19
- Priyom: Streaming generator + load profile scripts — 2026-03-19 (will provide Docker image)
- Monica: Tool schema + runbook — 2026-03-20
- Rafael: Share finalized MAP + evaluation plan with Procurement — 2026-03-19

Notes on timeline: If the cert issuance slips more than 48 hours, the final streaming test will need to be pushed by one week. Carla, can your infra team confirm their cert import window?

Attachment: streaming-playbook.pdf (baseline test profiles)

-- Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

- Tool calling schema: draft ready, pushing final JSON and mapping table by Fri (2026-03-20).
- Evaluation plan: I've annotated the MAP with the test cases we'll run during the streaming window (latency, partial outputs, tool hit rate).

That gives both teams time to validate client cert import on devices and run the mobile quickstart if needed. If Procurement needs the original PO timing, Rafael — please highlight the shift in the map doc so Procurement is aware of the extension.
